Vautrin (also: Captain Vautrin, Special Security and Surveillance Captain): A human Garde captain of Fontaine roughly 400 years ago who worked beside the Melusine Carole, killed those who framed her, was found guilty by Neuvillette, and founded the Mutual Aid Network in prison.

Status as of 7.1: Dead for about four centuries; remembered through Neuvillette's memories and the Mutual Aid Network.

311.content:
Venerare (also: Venerare of the Lawrence Clan, Venerare Lawrence): Venerare led the Lawrence Clan in the early days of Mondstadt, roughly 2,600 years ago. Under her guidance the people raised a tall statue in the city plaza for the Anemo Archon's descent, with an oath to protect Mondstadt carved beneath it. She is known from item text only.

Status as of 7.1: Dead for about 2,600 years; the manner of her death is not recorded.

312.content:
Vennessa (also: Falcon of the West, Lionfang Knight, Liontooth Knight, first Dandelion Knight, Hero of Mondstadt): A Muratan enslaved in Mondstadt about a thousand years ago, she fought as a gladiator, then with Barbatos' help led the rebellion that ended the aristocracy and founded the Knights of Favonius as its first Grand Master.

Status as of 7.1: Long dead; said to have ascended to Celestia at Windrise, where a vast oak now stands. Mondstadt honours her as its hero.

313.content:
Viaghara (also: Lord of the Forest, Greater Lord of the Labyrinths, Owner of the Moon-Mirrored Spring, Lord of All Animals, true tiger): Viaghara was the first lord of the forest, a divine "true tiger" born in Dharma Forest in the age when Greater Lord Rukkhadevata founded her rainforest. It was both her friend and the ruler of the forest's animals, and it helped protect the Varuna Contraption.

Status as of 7.1: Dead long ago. How Viaghara died is not recorded.

314.content:
Wandering Knight (also: Wolf Knight, First Knight of Boreas, Knight of Boreas (first), nameless knight of Boreas): The Wandering Knight was the first Knight of Boreas, a nameless warrior who arrived in Mondstadt about a thousand years ago, in Vennessa's time, with the wolf Boreas as his companion. He drank in taverns, hunted beasts and demons, refused the Knights of Favonius' repeated offers and left without a successor. The tales of the Wolf Knight grew from him.

Status as of 7.1: Presumed dead; his time is a millennium past. His sword symbol is among the Knights of Boreas and Grand Masters commemorated in the memorial space Varka crosses in 6.4, and his echo in the Ley Lines still tells Varka that his path is not finished.

315.content:
Wanjiru (also: the great runner, Uwezo bearer of the cataclysm, Kayeke's companion): Wanjiru, "the great runner", was a warrior of the Collective of Plenty and the first of six heroes to join Tenoch against the Abyss. She bore the Ancient Name Uwezo, "power", with her Tatankasaurus companion Kayeke, and died in the final battle five hundred years ago.

Status as of 7.1: Dead, about 500 years before the present day; her Name Uwezo now belongs to Iansan.

316.content:
Waskar (also: Waskar the younger twin, the younger of the twin heroes): Waskar was the younger of the twin heroes of Natlan's Collective of Plenty. He joined the Scarlet-Eyed Youth against the insane king of Ochkanatlan, stood first against the darkness on the day of the revolt, and was killed in the fighting.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. He was slain in the war against the king of Ochkanatlan, long before the Cataclysm.

key: One Entombed With the Primal Fire
317.content:
Xbalanque (also: Haborym, First Pyro Archon, The First Sun, Lanque, One Entombed With the Primal Fire, Dear Beloved Sun): Xbalanque (divine name Haborym) was the first Pyro Archon and God of War of Natlan, about 2,000 years ago. He began as a mortal outlander, slew the Pyro Dragon Xiuhcoatl, and bargained with Ronova, the Shade of Death, to write the rules Natlan uses against the Abyss. Natlanese remember him as "The First Sun".

Status as of 7.1: Dead; as of 7.1 his soul is in the Night Kingdom. In 5.3, after Natlan defeated the Abyss, Ronova honoured his bet and he returned for a single day in a borrowed body, then departed at sunset.

318.content:
Xiphos (also: Blade of Tulaytullah, Hero of Tulaytullah): Xiphos was a legendary hero of Tulaytullah, a prosperous desert city of sapphire domes and emerald gardens, in the age after King Deshret's kingdom fell. Born a crown prince and hidden as a servant, he became its famed "Blade of Tulaytullah" and was killed in a duel by an exiled prince hired by the city's rivals.

Status as of 7.1: Dead for thousands of years, slain in a duel.

319.content:
Xiuhcoatl (also: Flamelord, Pyro Dragon Sovereign, Pyro Dragon, Lord of Light and Heat, Master of Light and Flame, Master of Flame and Wisdom, Fallen Dragon): Xiuhcoatl, the Flamelord, was the Pyro Dragon Sovereign. He ruled Natlantea, ancient Natlan's dragon civilisation, and wielded light, heat, wisdom and the primal flame (Phlogiston).

Status as of 7.1: Dead. His remains lie in the Heart of the Sacred Mountain beneath the Great Volcano of Tollan; no new Pyro Dragon Sovereign exists as of 7.1.

key: the crimson princess of the snow
320.content:
Yalyane Morevna (also: Knyazhna of Blood, Princess of Blood, Morevna, first of the Snegovik, the crimson princess of the snow): Yalyane Morevna, the "Knyazhna of Blood", was the first of the Snegovik and princess of the House of Hesperides in the age after Hyperborea fell. She was feared for slaughtering fae kindreds, yet sheltered human clans, and she taught the young future Belyi Tsar the spear.

Status as of 7.1: Missing and presumed lost long ago: she vanished without trace before Monomakh founded Kitezhgrad, and no canon account says what became of her.

321.content:
Yelena (also: Vijava, the scholar Vijava): Yelena was a former Fatui member and the elder sister of Kirya. To spare him the rapid aging that a Delusion inflicts, she deserted with him and settled in Fontaine, where she posed as a Sumeru scholar named Vijava. She grew the flower used in the Auguste perfume, which drove Fontaine's 'Perfume Mania' about twenty years ago, and died in a fire she set to hide the secret.

Status as of 7.1: Dead for about twenty years as of the Pomum de Ambra Chapter; she died by self-immolation to protect the perfume's secret.

key: eighth head of the Yun Family
322.content:
Yun Huang (also: Huang of the Yun Family, eighth head of the Yun Family): Yun Huang was the eighth head of the Yun Family, a Liyue house of weaponsmiths, about five hundred years ago. The only child of Yun Hui, she was a headstrong martial artist who took over the forge herself when her father joined the Liyue Qixing. With Han Ce she is one of the two central figures in the Blackcliff weapon descriptions.

Status as of 7.1: Long dead; her death is not described. What remains is the Blackcliff line of weapons and her house, which later drifted from smithing towards the performing arts.

key: seventh head of the Yun Family
323.content:
Yun Hui (also: Hui of the Yun Family, seventh head of the Yun Family): Yun Hui was the seventh master of the Yun Family, a Liyue house renowned for forging weapons. After the Cataclysm he and the smith Han Wu designed the improved Prototype weapons, and he later left the forge to his daughter Yun Huang when he joined the Liyue Qixing.

Status as of 7.1: Long dead. Nothing describes his death; his work survives as the Prototype weapons and the Yun Family's later history.

324.content:
Yupanqui (also: Firethief, Fire-Bringer, Yupanqui the Firethief, Yupanqui the Fire-Bringer): Natlan's legendary Firethief: a boastful young swordsman who grew into a quiet, one-eyed veteran and died after stealing the Turnfire from the tyrant Och-Kan. The Scions of the Canopy claim him as their ancestor.

Status as of 7.1: Long dead, he is remembered as a hero and as a cautionary story about looking back.

325.content:
Zumurud (also: Verdant Lord, the Verdant Lord Zumurud): Zumurud, called the Verdant Lord, was a ruler of several desert city-states in the Great Red Sand, in Sumeru, thousands of years ago. He is known solely from Primal Obelisk inscriptions. He was the son of Muzaffar, one of the Deys of Orghana (the city later called Port Ormos), and was raised in the forest, so he did not speak the desert language. He dreamed of turning the desert green and fathered 99 children.

Status as of 7.1: Dead for thousands of years. He is mentioned only in ruin inscriptions and has no known presence in the present day.

326.content:
Acatl (also: Chief Acatl, Chief of the Collective of Plenty): Acatl is the chief of the Collective of Plenty, Natlan's farming and bodybuilding tribe. He is a tall, muscular man in a horned wrestling mask who welcomes visitors warmly and answers doubts with an invitation to the ring.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; chief of the Collective of Plenty in Atocpan as of 7.1.

327.content:
Adorno (also: Benevolent Knight, Grandpa Adorno, Captain Adorno): The genial, aging 'Benevolent Knight' and 5th Company Captain of the Knights of Favonius; dies in 6.6.

Status as of 7.1: Dead since A Knight's Resolve (6.6).

328.content:
Aedon (also: Illuga's nightingale, Solovei's nightingale): A glimmering golden nightingale who lights the way for the Lightkeeper Illuga, and who was once the bird of the legendary Torchforger Solovei.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and with Illuga in Nod-Krai.

329.content:
Ajaw (also: K'uhul Ajaw, Almighty Dragonlord, Aj Imuch' Paxlaq Lahun, Undying Wings of Lofty Isolation, Kinich's companion): A tiny pixel dragon in sunglasses bound to the Saurian Hunter Kinich. He calls himself the Almighty Dragonlord and insults everyone; in truth he is probably the Tenth Sovereign Lord, weakened and sealed in a wristband.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and bound to Kinich in Natlan, still unwilling to name which Lord he was.

330.content:
Aksinya (also: Court Jester of the Belyi Tsar, Royal Jester): A human survivor of Hyperborea raised by the Belyi Tsar as his "Court Jester", who led the Hvergelmir institute and tried to freeze love unchanging until the Traveler stopped her.

Status as of 7.1: Missing in the Shadow Realm as of 7.1, having fallen there with the Primordial Human.

331.content:
Alice (also: A, Merry-Witch, Dodo-King, Great Adventurer of the Realms, Mother of the Most Adorable Klee, Sustainer of the World's Borders, Crimson Chronicle, Defender of Old Mondstadt): Cheerful, theatrical founder of the Hexenzirkel (codename "A"), author of the Teyvat Travel Guide, mother of Klee and keeper of Teyvat's borders.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; called back to Teyvat's borders after Nod-Krai (6.2).

332.content:
Alkindi (also: Sage of Spantamad, Spantamad Sage): Alkindi is the current Sage of Spantamad, the Akademiya's school of elementalism and ley lines. Blunt, elderly and industrious, he is an old rival of the retired professor Cyrus.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; part of the Akademiya's response to the Irminsul crisis.

333.content:
Allpa (also: Elder Allpa, Tepal (assumed identity)): Flower-Feather Clan elder and veteran Qucusaur rider who, after her son Tepal died chasing flight, built the Phlogiston Wings and tried to seize the tribe from Chief Mutota.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, jailed with her followers in part of the workshop after the failed coup.

334.content:
Amina (also: Chief Amina, Chief of the People of the Springs): Amina is the chief of the People of the Springs, the hot-spring tribe of Natlan. She is earnest, inventive and responsible, the self-declared serious one among carefree people.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; chief of the People of the Springs at Toyac Springs as of 7.1.

335.content:
Andrei (also: Northland Bank manager in Liyue, Andrei of the Northland Bank): Andrei manages the Northland Bank's Liyue Harbor branch. By day he pitches loans and savings; off the clock he relaxes at the docks and admits he is growing fond of Liyue.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1: manager in Liyue Harbor, at the bank by day, the docks by night.

key: Great Wolf King of the North
336.content:
Andrius (also: Boreas, Lupus Boreas, Wolf of the North, Great Wolf King of the North, Dominator of Wolves, God of the North Wind, Lord of Wolvendom, Kingwolf of Boreas): An ancient wolf god of the far north, now a spirit in Wolvendom: the Wolf of the North among Mondstadt's Four Winds.

Status as of 7.1: A spirit in Wolvendom, watching his wolves and Razor.

337.content:
Ann (also: Oceanid Ann, Ann of Narzissenkreuz, Knight Ann): A small Oceanid of Fontaine, once the storybook 'knight' sent to rescue a princess, who learned the story was a dream and became her own person.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, travelling with Mary-Ann.

338.content:
Antei (also: Antigonus, Antigone, Transgressor): Antei (Antigonus) was an apprentice Jibashiri of Byakuyakoku in Enkanomiya, convicted of stealing a book he did not take. He is now a blunt, fierce-tempered Shade of Tokoyo afterimage who does not know he is dead.

Status as of 7.1: Dead; only an afterimage remains. He fades after the Traveler tells him he is innocent.

339.content:
Anthon (also: Tartaglia's younger brother): Anthon is one of Tartaglia's younger siblings, the second-youngest of the family: elder sister Tonia is above him and little brother Teucer below. He never appears on screen; he is known from Tartaglia's letters and from Tartaglia calling him and Tonia great kids.

Status as of 7.1: Presumed to be with his family in Snezhnaya as of 7.1. No canon scene shows him; his fate and activities after Tartaglia's letters are unstated.

340.content:
Apep (also: Dendro Dragon, Dendro Dragon Sovereign, Devourer of Divinity, Dragon of Verdure): Ruled Sumeru before the Heavenly Principles; a proud, scornful survivor of the dragons' lost war who holds a world of elemental lifeforms inside her.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in the Desert of Hadramaveth. She chose to observe the world rather than destroy it, and in 6.6 repaid Nahida with life force.

341.content:
Apepi (also: Uncle Apepi): Apepi is a cheerful man of the Shimti tribe who writes songs. He is seen only in the 6.1 Archon Quest 'Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion', in a memory of Nefer's childhood, where the girl calls him Uncle Apepi.

Status as of 7.1: Unknown. He appears only in the memory, before the Shimti's end.

342.content:
Arama (also: Aranara Arama, New Ashvattha Tree): A small Aranara of Vanarana, shy at first and then fiercely loyal. He guides the Traveler through the Aranyaka quests and becomes the new Ashvattha Tree so a Bija can be made to save the ailing Rana.

Status as of 7.1: The Aranyaka quests end with Arama as a sapling: the new Ashvattha Tree in the Land of Grounded Dreams.

343.content:
Ashru (also: Nefer's cat, the Curatorium cat): Nefer's pet cat, who sits on the counter of the Curatorium of Secrets in Nasha Town and welcomes clients in his own way.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and sitting at the Curatorium of Secrets counter in Nasha Town.

344.content:
Asmoday (also: Sustainer of Heavenly Principles, Unknown God, God of Space, Master of Space, Lord of Emptiness): A Shade of the Heavenly Principles who, in the Cataclysm, stopped the twin travelers leaving Teyvat, took the sibling and sealed the Traveler. She has since left Celestia and is seen with the sibling.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and at large; whereabouts unknown.

345.content:
Atea (also: Candlekeeper, Auntie Atea): Atea, the Candlekeeper of the People of the Springs, was a veteran warrior famed for her love of hot springs and strict rules about them. An Abyssal wound left her unable to fight or bathe, but she kept guarding her tribe until she died in the 5.0 story.

Status as of 7.1: Dead of Abyssal corrosion days after the 5.0 party; Mavuika saw her one last time. Her spirit later helped the Traveler in the Night Kingdom (5.3).

346.content:
Avaz (also: Northland Bank scammer, Avaz of the Northland Bank): Avaz is a Northland Bank employee in Snezhnograd. During the 7.1 Archon Quest he tried to sell Seals of Life to a supposed dying old man, was cornered by Alyosha, Odette and Vodyanitsa, and confessed that he had noticed Seals missing from the bank vault.

Status as of 7.1: In custody after the sting, to be handed to Fatui Internal Affairs on the Tsaritsa's word. As of 7.1 he is not seen again.

347.content:
Azar (also: Grand Sage Azar, Sage Azar, Rtawahist Sage): Former Grand Sage of the Sumeru Akademiya. He led the sages' secret plan with a Fatui Harbinger to build a new god, and fell when it failed.

Status as of 7.1: Alive. Removed from office and sent to Avidya Forest to cultivate wisdom after the Archon spared him. No present-day appearance since 3.2.

348.content:
Azhdaha (also: Geo Dragon, Earth Dragon, Sealed Lord of Vishaps, Ancient Geovishap Ancestor, Dragon King Azhdaha, Geo Dragon Sovereign): A colossal Geo dragon, once Morax's friend, driven mad by erosion and sealed beneath the Dragon-Queller at Nantianmen.

Status as of 7.1: Resealed beneath the Dragon-Queller after "No Mere Stone"; the wrathful body is dormant.

349.content:
Babel (also: Matriarch of the Tanit): Matriarch of the Tanit Eremites: gracious, devout in word, and a schemer in fact. Jeht killed her once her plot for the Eternal Oasis was exposed.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: Jeht killed her at the Tanit Camps after the Traveler exposed her lies.

350.content:
Baishi (also: Baishi the secretary, Hundred-Knowing, Ningguang's secretary): Baishi is one of Lady Ningguang's three secretaries in the Jade Chamber, a prim and fervently loyal aide who is happiest fussing over Ningguang's image.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and employed at the Jade Chamber as of 7.1; no change in canon.

351.content:
Baiwen (also: Baiwen the secretary, Hundred-Hearing, Ningguang's secretary): Baiwen is one of Lady Ningguang's three secretaries in the Jade Chamber, responsible for gathering and organising the intelligence that flows into it.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and employed at the Jade Chamber as of 7.1; no change in canon.

352.content:
Baixiao (also: Baixiao the secretary, Hundred-Understanding, Ningguang's secretary): Baixiao is one of Lady Ningguang's three secretaries in the Jade Chamber, a discreet, polite aide who receives guests and keeps business confidential.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and employed at the Jade Chamber as of 7.1; no change in canon.

353.content:
Baizhu's Master (also: Hu Tao's great-uncle, Old Hu's younger brother, the Chenyu Vale doctor): A Chenyu Vale physician from the Hu family of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. He bore Changsheng's contract, trained Baizhu and Jiangli, and died young. He exists only as a memory.

Status as of 7.1: Dead long before the Traveler's time; his tomb is where Baizhu vowed to end the contract.

354.content:
Baladhuri (also: Sage Baladhuri, Uncle Baladhuri, Vahumana Sage): Sage of the Vahumana Darshan at the Sumeru Akademiya: a kind, gentle scholar devoted to his students and family, jailed with Naphis for opposing the old regime.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in office as Vahumana Sage; last seen in 6.6 at Caravan Ribat during the Irminsul crisis.

355.content:
Barbeloth (also: Astromancer Barbeloth Trismegistus, Barbeloth Trismegistus, Barbeloth Megistus, Seer-Witch, Goddess of Prophecy, Barbie, Mona's master): Barbeloth, called B, is the elderly Hexenzirkel Seer-Witch, an astrologer and diviner who taught Mona.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at 7.1, running a fortune booth in Fontaine through a Dodoco stand-in.

356.content:
Beisht (also: The Avenger of the Vortex, Osial's wife, Final follower of the Overlord of the Vortex): A giant Hydro sea monster, Osial's wife and the last follower of the Overlord of the Vortex. She rose from a storm to avenge him when the Jade Chamber was rebuilt, and fled gravely wounded.

Status as of 7.1: Fled severely wounded in 2.4. Her whereabouts are unknown; Liyue remains watchful.

357.content:
Belozersky (also: Councilor Belozersky, Snezhnograd Veche Councilor): Belozersky is a councilor of the Snezhnograd Veche. In the 7.1 Archon Quest he faces a crowd outside Zapolyarny Palace asking why the Tsaritsa is collecting Seals of Life, confirms the Druzhna's donation, withholds the purpose, and is then told to return to his duties by Regrator.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and presumably still on the Snezhnograd Veche as of 7.1; not seen after the Palace scene.

358.content:
Benben (also: the strange machine, Jeht's construct): Benben is a small, friendly machine from the ruins of King Deshret's civilisation. It only beeps, but Jeht, who found and named it, says she understands what it feels. It can open the sealed doors of the old ruins.

Status as of 7.1: Active and travelling with Jeht as of its last appearance in 6.6.

359.content:
Bennu (also: Saint Bennu, Most-Radiant, Bennu the Most-Radiant, Pillar Bennu): Saint Bennu, the Most-Radiant, is an intelligent construct made by King Deshret to guard the gates of Aaru: a serious, earnest and proud guardian of the late king's legacy.

Status as of 7.1: Awake since 6.6 and helping maintain Aaru with Shesepankh.

360.content:
Biram (also: Chief Biram, Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind, Mictlan chief): Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind, Natlan's shaman tribe: courteous, reform-minded, eager to understand his tribe's mysteries without losing its traditions.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, chief at the Sacrificial Altar of Enigmatic Land, after the Abyss was driven back.

361.content:
Birgitta (also: Beep-Boopitta, Beep-Boopitta the Carrier Robot, Little Robot): A small cleaner-carrier combat robot made by Aino, who tags along with Ineffa, fixing, cleaning and fighting.

Status as of 7.1: Operating and travelling with Ineffa.

362.content:
Callirhoe (also: Spring Fairy, Fairy of Springvale): The Spring Fairy of Springvale: a gentle Oceanid from Fontaine who loves listening to people's dreams.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in spirit at Springvale after meeting Finch in 4.1.

363.content:
Capitano (also: Il Capitano, The Captain, Thrain, Sentinel Knight): Thrain, a cursed Khaenri'ahn knight. In Natlan he went from Mavuika's rival to her ally, then died in her place (5.3).

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 dead or beyond reach: in 5.3 he merged with the Lord of the Night in Mavuika's place. His body sits dormant on the Throne of the Primal Fire.

364.content:
Cardinal Calvin (also: Calvin): A cardinal of the Church of Favonius who runs its affairs while Seneschal Seamus Pegg is away. Barbara says he is so busy he seldom leaves his room.

Status as of 7.1: Last known as acting Seneschal while Seamus was away. His current fate is unknown.

365.content:
Chang the Ninth (also: Chang the Ninth of Feiyun Slope, Big Nine, Old Chang): A pompous, down-on-his-luck ore merchant in Qingce Village who boasts of his Feiyun Slope glory days. Devoted book collector and author of First Apprentice of Guhua.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Qingce Village. His novel won, but the sakoku decree blocked Yae's royalties; he later received Mr. Nine's buried savings. He keeps writing.

366.content:
Changsheng (also: Herblord, Yao Jun, the Jade Snake, Baizhu's snake): Baizhu's white snake companion, once the Herblord, an adeptus of Chenyu Vale. Her contract trades a doctor's health for the power to cure.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, at Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor with Baizhu.

367.content:
Charles (also: Angel's Share bartender, Angel's Share's bartender): Charles is the bartender of Angel's Share, the Dawn Winery's tavern in Mondstadt. Courteous and practical, he has worked there for over a decade.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as far as canon shows; tends the bar at Angel's Share.

368.content:
Chef Mao (also: Mao, Boss of Wanmin Restaurant, Xiangling's father): Proud, easygoing owner and chef of Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue Harbor, a veteran with over two decades in the kitchen. He is Xiangling's father and first teacher.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and running Wanmin Restaurant in Liyue Harbor; open at all hours.

369.content:
Chlothar (also: Chlothar Alberich, Eide): A Khaenri'ahn Alberich noble who tried to save his cursed hilichurl son Caribert, turned to the Abyss, and founded the Abyss Order. Seen only in the sibling's memory.

Status as of 7.1: Unknown. He vanished a century after founding the Order; remains in his old field may be his.

370.content:
Chugunov (also: Director Chugunov, Iskra Manufacturing Plant Boss, Iskra Plant owner): A wealthy, short-tempered Snezhnayan owner of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant who boasts of a loving family, long since lost.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnaya as of 7.1, having ordered his factory wound down.

371.content:
Chuychu (also: Chuychu of the Flower-Feather Clan): A Flower-Feather doctor who treated Abyssal contamination, adoptive younger sister of Chasca. She died of Abyssal injuries in the invasion of Natlan.

Status as of 7.1: Dead since the Abyssal invasion (5.1); listed among the memorialised. A spirit in a Night Kingdom dream (5.3).

372.content:
Clymene (also: Sunchildren's attendant): Clymene was a Byakuyakoku official who tended the Sunchildren in the Dainichi Mikoshi and loved them though forbidden to speak. As a shade she asks the Traveler to help lay them to rest.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. She fades once the Sunchildren are laid to rest. No later appearance found.

373.content:
Comonqui (also: Scorching Star, Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames): A Pyro Abyss Lector called the Scorching Star who invaded the Night Kingdom, killed Mallko and was defeated by Kachina and Mualani.

Status as of 7.1: Defeated in the Night Kingdom; no later appearance.

374.content:
Crepus (also: Crepus Ragnvindr, Master Crepus, Master of the Dawn Winery): Crepus Ragnvindr, called Master Crepus: late owner of the Dawn Winery, Diluc's father and Kaeya's adoptive father. He died shielding Diluc about four years before the story.

Status as of 7.1: Dead since Diluc's eighteenth birthday; his manor still holds the art he collected.

375.content:
Cusco (also: Chasca's father, Chasca's adoptive father, Uncle Cusco): Cusco is a Flower-Feather Clan man who became Chasca's adoptive father. He is a loving, anxious parent grieving a daughter and worrying about another.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in the Flower-Feather Clan, still worried about Chasca. No later appearance found.

376.content:
Dainsleif (also: Dain, Bough Keeper, Twilight Sword, Captain Dain): Immortal former Royal Guard captain, the Twilight Sword, five centuries into his fight against the Abyss Order. Curt and guarded, he sells help for a price and honest answers.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, in Snezhnaya after helping defeat Ronova, eager to leave.

377.content:
Danica (also: Danica Postelnitskaya, Head Maid of Zapolyarny Palace): Danica Postelnitskaya is the head maid of Zapolyarny Palace and one of the Tsaritsa's two closest attendants. Exacting, formal, deadpan; a former wandering mercenary.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving as head maid at Zapolyarny Palace as of Version 7.1.

378.content:
Demyan (also: The Flagship Bartender, "The Flagship" Bartender): The friendly young bartender and innkeeper of The Flagship tavern in Nasha Town, selling food, drinks and recipes.

Status as of 7.1: Behind the bar at The Flagship in Nasha Town, serving customers.

379.content:
Descartes (also: Prune's imaginary friend, the purple puppy): A small purple dog, Prune's imaginary friend, born of her need for someone to talk to about her books.

Status as of 7.1: Restored and with Prune after the Phantasmal Pals event.

380.content:
Dex (also: Dexter, juvenile Watcher): Dex (Dexter) is a juvenile Watcher of the Temple of Space, shaped like a hand with an eye, who helps the Traveler free the temple from Melanta.

Status as of 7.1: In the Temple of Space after Melanta's defeat.

381.content:
Donskoy (also: Donskoy the snow giant, the giant of ice and snow, the chained giant, Eitr-Altered Snegovik): A Snegovik who became a giant of ice and snow through Pavlina's forbidden Eitr, was chained, and was freed to keep a promise at a lighthouse.

Status as of 7.1: After lighting the lighthouse he walks into the sea and is not seen again. His fate is unknown at the cutoff.

key: Exalted Master of the Heretical Path
382.content:
Dottore (also: Il Dottore, The Doctor, Zandik, Escher, Omega Build, Segment 35, Heretic of the False Moon, False Moon God): Il Dottore, 'The Doctor', is the Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers: a brilliant, amoral researcher whose given name is Zandik. Expelled from the Sumeru Akademiya for unauthorised, unethical work, he joined the Fatui to get the resources to turn humans into something godlike, and treats people, allies and enemies alike as parts of an experiment. In the story he is a recurring adversary through Sumeru and Nod-Krai. He is dead as of Version 6.6: Columbina killed his body with a moonbeam, and he burned away when Nahida set Irminsul alight.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. Columbina incinerated his body with a moonbeam in Nod-Krai (6.3), which was half of his plan; Pantalone then uploaded his data into Irminsul. There he merged, took over the system, and was burned with it when Nahida used the Pyro Gnosis in Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana (6.6). He said goodbye to Pantalone and Nahida first.

383.content:
Dr. Edith (also: Edith, Edith Musk, Doctor Edith): A Mondstadt historian and folklore researcher who can be found by the Statue of The Seven at Windrise gathering material for her new book. She loves telling the legend of Vennessa.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt, found beside the Windrise Statue of The Seven by day. Nothing in canon through 7.1 changes her situation.

384.content:
Draff (also: Draff Kätzlein, Oddears the Incredible Hunter, Uncle Brown Cat, Head of the Hunters): The head hunter of Springvale and Diona's father. By day he sells fresh game; at night he drinks to the hunt.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working in Springvale, unchanged by anything in canon through 7.1.

key: Lesser Lord Kusanali's most faithful follower
385.content:
Dunyarzad (also: Dunyarzad Homayani, Miss Homayani, Miss Dunyarzad, Lesser Lord Kusanali's most faithful follower): A gentle, stubbornly hopeful young woman of Sumeru City's wealthy Homayani family. Born with the incurable illness Eleazar, she slipped out to revive the neglected Sabzeruz Festival for Lesser Lord Kusanali.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and cured: Eleazar vanished from Sumeru after Rukkhadevata's tainted consciousness was cleansed from the Irminsul.

386.content:
Dvalin (also: Stormterror, Wind Dragon, Anemo Dragon, Dragon of the East, Dragon of Mondstadt, Tyrant of the Skies, Howling Hurricane of Mondstadt): Anemo Dragon, Dragon of the East, Barbatos' ancient friend. Abyssal poison made him 'Stormterror'; freed in the Prologue.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and cleansed, near Mondstadt.

387.content:
Dymov (also: Theater Staff Dymov, the staff member who went for blankets): A staff member at the Korolevskiy Theater who takes the commemorative photo after the Spirit Seeker preview, then steps out into the blizzard to fetch blankets and is never seen again.

Status as of 7.1: Last seen running into the snowstorm. His fate is not stated in the quests read, through Version 7.1.

388.content:
Edwin Eastinghouse (also: Edwin, Mr. Edwin, Eastinghouse): Genius former senior researcher of the Fontaine Research Institute whose Arkhium experiment destroyed its central laboratory. Declared dead, he was found in hiding and sent to the Fortress of Meropide, and he still wants to resume his research.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; imprisoned in the Fortress of Meropide since 4.2.

389.content:
Efim Snezhevich (also: The Teacher, Teacher (Fatui)): A stern Fatui instructor from the House of the Hearth, called the Teacher, who led a cell in Inazuma that planned to poison Watatsumi Island and restart the war.

Status as of 7.1: Recalled to Snezhnaya after his Inazuma plot failed; whereabouts unknown as of 7.1.

390.content:
Ehrnrooth (also: Priestess of the Frostmoon Scions): A chatty young Frostmoon Scions priestess who shelves books in the Frostmoon Enclave library and dreams of writing a humorous book of tales about the Moonchanters.

Status as of 7.1: Sorting books in the Frostmoon Enclave library, drafting a book titled 'Lost Tales of the Moonchanters'.

391.content:
Ekaterina (also: Northland Bank receptionist, Ekaterina of the Northland Bank): A masked Fatui receptionist at the Northland Bank in Liyue Harbor. She serves customers courteously while declining to admit the bank is the Fatui's.

Status as of 7.1: Last shown at the Northland Bank counter in Liyue Harbor. No change has been shown through 7.1.

392.content:
Ella Musk (also: Professor Ella Musk, Scholar of Hilichurlian Linguistics): A young-looking scholar in the Knights of Favonius library who studies the Hilichurlian language and wishes she could talk to a living hilichurl. She hands out Hilichurl Ballad Selection, Vol. 2.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt, working in the library. Nothing in canon through 7.1 changes her situation.

393.content:
Elphane (also: Navia Line guide): A Melusine who guides the Navia Line aquabus in Fontaine. Polite, formal and deadpan, she recites route announcements and the official line of the Court Region Waterway Hub, and is easily flustered by compliments.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and still guiding the Navia Line as of Version 7.1; she has no appearance in the 6.x or 7.0-7.1 stories.

394.content:
Enjou (also: Sanka, Kokuchuu, Hayne, Tenoyollotzin, Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames, The Devouring Benthic Flame, The Thing Calling Itself Enjou): Enjou is a Pyro Abyss Lector who poses as a friendly human scholar, appearing in Enkanomiya and Natlan under different names while looking for a homeland he cannot remember.

Status as of 7.1: Last seen in the Mare Jivari as of 5.8, looking for his homeland. Whether he is alive is not stated.

395.content:
Eroch (also: Inspector Eroch, the Inspector, Cold Voice): Eroch was the Knights of Favonius' Inspector. Resentful of Varka and in league with Dottore, he unsealed Ursa the Drake, which led to Crepus's death, then ordered it hidden. The Knights exposed him; he died by his own hand before the story.

Status as of 7.1: Dead by his own hand before the story begins.

396.content:
Euphrosiniya (also: Euphie, Euphrosiniya Ignatyevna Trubetskaya, Privy Councillor Trubetskaya): A tired, outspoken Snezhnograd Veche councillor who heads House Trubetskoy and pushes for heat and food for the poor of Zolnyy.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving in the Snezhnograd Veche State Hall, pressing for a budget proposal.

397.content:
Faranak (also: Kaveh's mother): Faranak is Kaveh's mother, a famous architect trained in the Akademiya's Kshahrewar Darshan. She lost her husband and, years later, moved to Fontaine to start a new life, leaving Kaveh her home in Sumeru.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and living in Fontaine, working in architecture, as of the latest mention.

398.content:
Ferigees (also: Guardian of the Eternal Oasis, Last mother of the Jinn, Guardian of Ay-Khanoum, Ferigees the Jinni): A Jinni who sealed her spirit in a machine to guard the Eternal Oasis; destroyed in 3.4 when she barred Liloupar and the Traveler.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: her machine was destroyed in 3.4.

399.content:
Firnas (also: Sage Firnas, Kshahrewar Sage, Sage of Kshahrewar): Firnas is the Akademiya's current Kshahrewar Sage, the head of the mechanics Darshan. In the 6.6 Archon Quest he helps the sages work out how to answer the Irminsul anomaly and rebuild a replacement for the Akasha Terminal.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving as Kshahrewar Sage as of 7.1.

400.content:
Flora (also: Flora of Floral Whisper, Owner of Floral Whisper): Flora is the owner of Floral Whisper, the flower shop in Mondstadt City. She is gentle and cheerful and her favourite flower is the dandelion.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt City, running Floral Whisper. Nothing in canon through 7.1 changes her situation.

401.content:
Focalors (also: Foçalors, Archon Focalors, God of Justice, Mirror-me, Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws): Focalors was the second and last Hydro Archon, Fontaine's God of Justice. Once an Oceanid that Egeria made human, she inherited a prophecy that her people would dissolve into the sea. To trick the Heavenly Principles she split off her human half, Furina, to play the god in public, and hid her own divinity inside the Oratrice. In 4.2 she executed herself, destroying the Hydro Archon's throne and saving everyone. She is dead.

Status as of 7.1: Dead since 4.2. She executed herself through the Oratrice. Her throne is gone, the Hydro authority is Neuvillette's, and the Fontainians are true humans.

402.content:
Frederica Gunnhildr (also: Frederica, Alder Knight, Captain Frederica): Frederica Gunnhildr, the Alder Knight: veteran Knights of Favonius captain, mother of Jean and Barbara, away on a secret mission.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; on a secret mission only Varka and Jean are said to know.

403.content:
Fujin (also: Big Sis Fujin, Golden Carp, the Carp adeptus, Fujin of the North): A golden-carp adeptus of Chenyu Vale who planted its first tea tree and helped save its people from a flood. Weakened by the ages, she asks the Traveler to help restore the vale.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Chenyu Vale, near Qiaoying Village.

404.content:
Furiosa (also: Furiosa the Guardian, Lingering Guardian, Guardian of What Is No More, Voywolf Hunter Furiosa): A Volkodlak archer of the hidden village Okurov, the first to be changed by Koshchei's alchemy and the one who turned away at the end of it.

Status as of 7.1: Defeated at the Hall of Prayers by the Traveler; her fate afterward is unknown. She remains a Local Legend near the Scars of Cursed Obsession domain.

405.content:
Gediminas (also: The Knave's Subordinate, Arlecchino's Oprichnik): A Fatui Oprichnik in Arlecchino's unit, met in Nod-Krai. He brings the Traveler's allies a map and a warning that Dottore is at his northern laboratory.

Status as of 7.1: After handing over the map in the Curatorium of Secrets he leaves for the Experimental Design Bureau.

406.content:
Goth (also: Ludwig Goth, Master Goth, Boss of the Goth Grand Hotel): Ludwig Goth owns the Goth Grand Hotel and Dawn Breeze Inn in Mondstadt City. The Fatui have booked his whole hotel.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt City at 7.1, usually on a bench in the park south of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters, saying he is on holiday.

407.content:
Guoba (also: Marchosius, God of the Stove, Stove God, Patron God of the Soil, Xiangling's companion): Xiangling's orange companion, who breathes fire and loves spicy food. He is secretly Marchosius, the diminished God of the Stove.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and well in Liyue at Xiangling's side.

408.content:
Haden (also: Wyrdsword of Heaven's End, Iniquitous Baptist (Haden)): Dainsleif's old swordsmanship teacher, now an immortal Abyss Order Iniquitous Baptist. He says most of his memories and emotions have eroded, and he lied to lure Dainsleif into feeding the Loom of Fate his memories.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and immortal. Dainsleif killed him a hundred times for joining the Order and a hundred more for his lie.

409.content:
Halfdan (also: Black Serpent Knight: Windcutter): A Royal Guard elite of Khaenri'ah, cursed into a Black Serpent Knight, who kept his captain's last order to protect the people. In the Chasm he guarded dying hilichurls and died stopping an Abyss Order device.

Status as of 7.1: Dead since 2.6: he stopped an Abyss Order device at the cost of his life.

410.content:
Hanachirusato (also: Masked Maiden): A masked shrine maiden who asks the Traveler to help with the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. She is filth condensed from the Kitsune Saiguu's memories, so finishing the rite will end her.

Status as of 7.1: Gone: she dissipates at the end of the ritual and leaves her mask.

411.content:
Hark (also: Hark the Crackjaw, Crackjaw, the Crackjaw, Helmsman of the Atlas): Hark the Crackjaw, ex-helmsman of the pirate ship Atlas, tried to go straight, was accused of a theft, and ended as a killer hiding behind a hermit's mask. Nefer and the Traveler killed him.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: killed in The Dust Settles (6.1).

412.content:
Hertha (also: Captain Hertha, Miss Hertha, Captain of the 6th Company, Logistics Captain of the Knights of Favonius): Hertha is the Knights of Favonius captain in charge of logistics and supplies, and the Knight who handles Mondstadt's Reputation system. In 5.6 it emerges that she vanished by plan to help trap an impostor.

Status as of 7.1: Alive after Paralogism (5.6) and still the logistics captain and Reputation contact in Mondstadt's Market District. No later appearance found.

413.content:
Heryshaf (also: Goat King, Minister of Ministers, Goatie): The Goat King, a ram-headed ancient god and the chief of King Deshret's Seven Pillars. After long confinement in Aaru he is free again, staying at Sumeru's Temple of Silence, dry-witted, watchful and sparing with opinions.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and free since Version 6.6. At the end of Act X he and Thoth plan to stay at the Temple of Silence in Sumeru, for a while at least, pending a talk with its leader Sethos.

414.content:
Hiiragi Chisato (also: Chisato, Lady Hiiragi, Young Lady of the Hiiragi Clan): Hiiragi Chisato is the daughter of Hiiragi Shinsuke of the Kanjou Commission in Ritou and the sweetheart of Kujou Kamaji. After her father's imprisonment she became the household's leading figure.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Ritou; wedding postponed indefinitely. Status in 6.x and 7.0-7.1 unknown.

415.content:
Hiiragi Shinsuke (also: Kanjou Commissioner): Genial Kanjou Commissioner of Ritou and head of the Hiiragi Clan. He is also a Fatui collaborator who tries to keep the Traveler trapped on the island, and he was later arrested.

Status as of 7.1: Detained for his part in the Fatui plot, as the wiki records. His daughter leads the clan.

416.content:
Hintsa (also: Hintsa the mechanic, Aino's apprentice): A Nasha Town mechanic who trained under Aino and works from the Rossum Workshop, fixing simple machines and maintaining some of Aino's inventions.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Nasha Town, working on commissions for Aino and others.

417.content:
Hroptatyr (also: The Wise, Chief Royal Mage): Abyssal power made him a Sinner; he left Teyvat to seek infinite knowledge.

Status as of 7.1: Unknown. After the cataclysm he left Teyvat to merge with the Abyss; only a memory echo of him speaks.

418.content:
Hu Tao's Father (also: Hu Tao's Dad, 76th Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the 76th director): The late 76th director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Hu Tao's father. A gifted spellcaster who died at Wuwang Hill, he appears only as a spirit.

Status as of 7.1: Dead about a decade; seen only as a spirit in a limited-time event.

419.content:
Huffman (also: Huffman Schmidt, Knight Huffman): Huffman Schmidt is a patrol Knight of Favonius in Mondstadt City, found across from the Angel's Share, and the older brother of Mika.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and on patrol in Mondstadt City as of the 6.4 event; no later changes found.

420.content:
Huixin (also: Huixin the secretary, Secretary of Yuehai Pavilion, Uncle Tian's daughter): A secretary at Yuehai Pavilion, the Qixing's office on Yujing Terrace, and Uncle Tian's daughter. She joined the staff because she grew up admiring Ganyu.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working at Yuehai Pavilion as of 7.1, with no change in canon.

421.content:
Istaroth (also: Ruler of Time, Kairos, Tokoyo Ookami, Laimelea, Mother of Time, Master of Time, Mother of the Thousand Winds, Mother of Time and Wind): Istaroth is the Ruler of Time, one of the four Shades the Heavenly Principles made when they came to Teyvat. She is a tall, pale goddess with a clock-like gaze whom almost no one remembers, yet she has quietly steered events for thousands of years. She is bored and detached, and she acts through small, deniable nudges.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and intact as of Version 7.1. The last time she was seen was in the Irminsul scene (6.6), where she sat in judgment with two other Shades.

422.content:
Iwakura Mitsunari (also: Iwakura Kouin, Kouin, Soushu of the Iwakura Art): Iwakura Mitsunari (Kouin) was the last Soushu of the Iwakura Art. His Vision was taken, his disciples left, and he now serves as a bewildered Kujou sword instructor until he duels the Traveler.

Status as of 7.1: Dead, slain by the Traveler in Iwakura Art's Downfall. No later appearance found.

423.content:
Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk (also: Mirror of the Dawning Morn, Eleventh Lord, Eleventh Sovereign Lord, Ix Raq'lapuj, CL-11): The proud, human-hating Eleventh of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords, a dragon-age AI. Dead as of 5.8.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. She died in the Temple of Cascading Colors, Searing, 5.8.

424.content:
Jakob Ingold (also: Jakob, Jakob Baker): A centuries-old 'neohuman' and co-founder of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo, working to forge the Holy Blade and bring back his Master, his adoptive brother Rene.

Status as of 7.1: Presumed dead: crushed by the Doomsday Clock in 4.2.

425.content:
Javert (also: Fatui Javert, Agent - Incinerating Blades, the Fatui Pyro Agent, Northland Bank debt collector): A masked Fatui Pyro Agent in Liyue Harbor who collects debts for the Fatui's Northland Bank and gets involved in Maocai's Cor Lapis scheme.

Status as of 7.1: Last seen leaving the Feiyun warehouse in Liyue Harbor; later whereabouts unknown.

426.content:
Jebrael (also: Treacherous Grit, Twin Blades of Thutmose, Jeht's father): Jeht's father, an Eremite who left the band Thutmose to raise her. He guides Tirzad's expedition and dies stopping his old comrade Samail; his soul is freed in 6.6.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. He died inside the Golden Slumber stopping Samail. His soul was released in 6.6.

427.content:
Jeht (also: Jeht Ufairah Hindi, Jeht Tanit): A scarred, blunt young desert mercenary and the Traveler's friend, who lost her father to the Golden Slumber, destroyed the Tanit tribe, and now leads her own band with the construct Benben.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 she is alive, leading her own mercenary band in Sumeru's desert and in touch with Nefer's Curatorium of Secrets. She has no known role in the Snezhnaya arc.

428.content:
Jiu (also: A-Jiu, the girl at the Dragon-Queller, Azhdaha's rage): A blue-haired girl by the Dragon-Queller who speaks of an ancient being's coming resurrection. She is the embodiment of Azhdaha's wrath, not a human child.

Status as of 7.1: Faded away in 'No Mere Stone' (1.5); no appearance since.

429.content:
Jotautas (also: The Doctor's Subordinate, Columbina's former Oprichnik): A Fatui Oprichnik stationed in Nod-Krai who first served Columbina, then Dottore, and tells the Traveler's party what he knows about the Doctor.

Status as of 7.1: After talking to the party he leaves the facility. Whether he reached the Design Bureau is not shown.

430.content:
Kaiyang (also: Lord Kaiyang, the Kaiyang, Kaiyang of the Liyue Qixing, Mizar of the Seven Stars): The unnamed Kaiyang, one of the seven current members of the Liyue Qixing. Known only through mentions: a wargame proposal, a comment on Ningguang and a request for troop manpower.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, unnamed, and still a Qixing member as of 7.1; last mentioned in 5.7.

431.content:
Kaleva (also: Kaleva the Treasure Hoarder): A Treasure Hoarder near Starsand Shoal who knows Jahoda. He and two subordinates stole Ihanti's bag, then lost a fight to Jahoda and the Traveler and handed the loot back.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and unharmed beyond a beating. Returned the goods.

432.content:
Katarina (also: Katarina Snezhevna, Katarina of the Ninth Company): A Fatui Electro Cicin Mage of the Ninth Company, stranded in The Chasm. Dry, tired and loyal, she searches for her brother Nikolay.

Status as of 7.1: Last seen in a hideout in The Chasm, about to look for Nikolay; fate unknown.

433.content:
Katheryne (also: Katheryne the Receptionist, Guild Receptionist, Adventurers' Guild receptionist): Katheryne is the Adventurers' Guild receptionist, a polite and unflappable puppet who staffs the counter in every nation and hands out commissions.

Status as of 7.1: Working at the Guild counters in every region as of 7.1, including the headquarters in Snezhnograd.

434.content:
Katya (also: Boss of Speranza, Aunty Katya, Big Sis Katya): Katya owns Speranza in Nasha Town and gives street children shelter, work and food as the Conch Gang. She is a retired Treasure Hoarder.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, running Speranza in Nasha Town.

435.content:
Khajeh (also: Sage Khajeh, Haravatat Sage (former)): Khajeh was the Sumeru Akademiya's sage of the Haravatat Darshan during the plot to make a new god. He pressed Tighnari to join the project in Version 3.0, helped run the Sabzeruz Festival samsara and was exiled after it failed.

Status as of 7.1: Exiled from the Akademiya after the failure of the plan, according to the wiki.

436.content:
Kirya (also: Edgar, Edgar the flower expert): Yelena's younger brother. For years he lived in Port Ormos, Sumeru, as 'Edgar', a respected flower expert and perfumery teacher, while quietly planning revenge on the people he blamed for his sister's death.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, in the custody of the Eremites after Base Note: Auguste. His trial and sentence are not described, though Emilie visited him beforehand.

437.content:
Klingsor (also: Forsaker of the True Way, Priest of the Dark Hollow, Servant of the Dark Hollow, Abyss Herald Klingsor): A former Order of Skeptics ranger who became an Abyss Herald centuries ago and later helps Nasejuna try to steal the Great Songs of Khvarena.

Status as of 7.1: Defeated by the Traveler in 3.6. His fate is not stated; he has not reappeared.

438.content:
Koitar (also: Goddess of the Dawnstar, Dawn's Navigator, Mother of Dawn, Mother of Night, Princess of the Morning Star, Angel of Angels): First angel of Celestia, later a rebel god who ruled Hyperborea with Anacharsis for thirty years.

Status as of 7.1: Memory restored; she vowed to return to Hyperborea's ruins and wait there for Anacharsis.

439.content:
Koshchei (also: Koshchei the Deathless, The Deathless, Doctor Moreau, Thing That Used to be Nastya): A cold Snezhnayan bio-alchemist of Hvergelmir, called the Deathless. He made the Aberrant Chimeric Monsters, helped create the Eye of Graeae, and pursued an eternal life called the Perfect Tree.

Status as of 7.1: The presence behind the Perfect Tree in Flamefeather Valley; whether he lives is unclear.

440.content:
Kujou Kamaji (also: Kamaji, Lord Kamaji, Proxy Clan Head, Provisional Clan Head, Acting Kujou Clan Head): Younger son of the Kujou Clan's fallen head, a Tenryou Commission official in Inazuma City and now provisional clan head. Earnest and polite, he quietly doubts the Shogun's harsher policies.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; provisional Kujou head in Inazuma City as of 7.1, awaiting the Shogun's verdict on his clan.

441.content:
Kujou Masahito (also: Masahito, Lord Masahito, General Masahito): Eldest son of the Kujou Clan head and an officer of the Shogun's Army commanding at the Kujou Encampment. Stern and honourable, he doubts the Vision Hunt Decree yet keeps fighting.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and stationed at the Kujou Encampment in Kannazuka as of Version 7.1, as far as canon shows. Watchful about the truce.

442.content:
Kujou Takayuki (also: Takayuki, Lord Kujou, Tenryou Commissioner Takayuki, Head of the Kujou Clan, Kujou Clan Head): Former Tenryou Commissioner and Kujou Clan head who secretly took a Fatui deal (a promised reward) to keep the Vision Hunt Decree going; exposed in Chapter II (2.1), now confined awaiting judgment.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; removed from his posts, confined indefinitely without bail, awaiting judgment.

443.content:
Kulish (also: Kulish of the Korolevskiy Theater, Theater Staff): Kulish is a staff member of the Korolevskiy Theater in Snezhnograd, the man at the door who checks tickets, keeps the duty logbook and shows guests to their rooms. He is polite, careful and a little starstruck by the theater's stars.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1, alive in the real Korolevskiy Theater, with no memory of the shared dream in which he died.

444.content:
Kusayla (also: Dehya's father, leader of Dakan Al-Ahmar, the boss of Dakan Al-Ahmar): Kusayla led Dakan Al-Ahmar, a brigade of Eremite mercenaries, and raised the foundling Dehya. He is dead before the main story.

Status as of 7.1: Dead some years before the main story, after burning the Relics' records room. His cane and belongings went to Dehya.

445.content:
Lan (also: Huo Lanling, Swordseeker of Qingxu, Branch Master Lan, Miss Lan): Branch Master of the Adventurers' Guild in Liyue Harbor, a former mercenary more interested in finding her missing brother's sword, the Unseen Razor, than in running the Guild.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; still searching for her brother and the sword.

446.content:
Lan Yu (also: Head of the Lan Clan, Lan Yan's uncle): The head of the Lan clan of thaumaturges in Chenyu Vale and Lan Yan's uncle.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Chenyu Vale, where he has returned to Yilong Wharf after the Millelith operation.

447.content:
Liloupar (also: Liloufar, Mother of the Jinn, Jinn-Mother, Daughter of the Water Lily, Mother of the Despicable): She engineered Gurabad's fall as revenge on her husband, and later served the Traveler from a magic bottle.

Status as of 7.1: Faded in 6.6 after taking Nabu Malikata's remains from Collei at Windrise; alive before that.

key: Beastlord of the Sunken Jade Realm
448.content:
Lingyuan (also: Bluey, Mountain Lord, Beastlord of the Sunken Jade Realm, the Solitary Suanni): A blue suanni, lord of the wild mountains of Chenyu Vale. Blunt and precise, she tried to return the vale to nature so her friend Fujin could regain her power.

Status as of 7.1: Alive near Chenyu Vale; she watches humans and visits Fujin.

449.content:
Lumi (also: Linnea's Jack Frost, the yellow Jack Frost): A small yellow-brown Jack Frost who follows Linnea everywhere, eating shiny things and fighting with Geo hammers.

Status as of 7.1: With Linnea in Nod-Krai, still carrying on as her companion.

450.content:
Luneva (also: Doctor Luneva, Dr. Luneva): Doctor Luneva is a practical, good-humoured Snezhnograd doctor who visits Podvorye Restaurant to examine a feverish Paimon. She is a friend of the hunter Alyosha.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and practising in Snezhnaya as of 7.1.

451.content:
Luonnotar (also: the Luonnotar, Columbina's familiar, the rabbit-like kuuhenki, Moon Goddess's blessing): A rare rabbit-eared kuuhenki who appears out of Moon-Prayer petals and follows the Traveler. Silent but expressive, she is a piece of Columbina's soul given a life of her own.

Status as of 7.1: Alive at the Silvermoon Hall with Columbina, reborn with her own will in 6.3.

452.content:
Lyudmila: A masked Fatui diplomat posted in Mondstadt, always found beside her colleague Mikhail, who voices the group's worries while he waves them away.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt as of her latest dialogue, which reacts to the Nod-Krai incident. She still waits by the waypoint, worrying about the Doctor and Marionette's trouble and the coming Project Stuzha.

453.content:
Lyudochka Snezhevna (also: Gendou Ringo, Touyama, Ringo): A Fatui spy from the House of the Hearth who posed as the shrine maiden Gendou Ringo, was exposed by the Traveler, and chose to stay in Inazuma as a real shrine maiden.

Status as of 7.1: Safe at the Grand Narukami Shrine, now known as Gendou Ringo. She has left the Fatui for good.

454.content:
Lyulka (also: Rossum Workshop Researcher): A researcher who minds the Rossum Workshop in Nasha Town for her father, sells weapon diagrams and forges to order. She would rather daydream and tinker with kuuvahki than call herself a smith.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and working in Nasha Town as of Version 7.1.

455.content:
Madame Ping (also: Streetward Rambler, Ping Laolao): An elderly flower-lover at Yujing Terrace in Liyue Harbor, secretly the old adeptus Streetward Rambler.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Liyue Harbor, tending Glaze Lilies at Yujing Terrace by day.

456.content:
Maite (also: Maite Veliu, Heir of Reed Miller): A boastful young member of the Conch Gang who calls herself the heir of the legendary thief Reed Miller. She teams up with the Traveler to take the Crab Tsar's cursed stone, then becomes their friend.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Nasha Town and near Crab Tsar's Palace, keeping watch over the calmed Crab Tsar.

457.content:
Mamere (also: Mamère): A Melusine painter born in Elynas. Unlike others of her kind she can still hear her 'father', Elynas, and she cares for the damaged clockwork dog Seymour. After the Ancient Colors quests she travels with him and the people they have gathered.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, travelling with Seymour. Last seen at Sandrone's tea parties in Version 6.7; no later canon found through 7.1.

458.content:
Marcel (also: Vacher, Marcel of the Confrerie of Cabriere): A Fontainian businessman, head of the Confrerie of Cabriere, who was secretly Vacher, a Snezhnayan adventurer. He abducted young women for Primordial Seawater experiments meant to bring back his lover Vigneire.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: found guilty by the Oratrice, then drowned by an Oceanid at the Fountain of Lucine.

459.content:
Margaret (also: Dame Workshy the Absentee Boss, Boss of the Cat's Tail, Cat's Tail owner): Margaret owns The Cat's Tail, a tavern in Mondstadt City, and roams the fountain plaza by day. She is playful and flirtatious, keeps cats, and hired Diona as her bartender.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and running The Cat's Tail in Mondstadt City, usually seen near the fountain plaza by day. No change found as of 7.1.

460.content:
Mary-Ann: Lives on as herself, neither Lyris nor the human.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; travelling with Ann, Seymour and Mamere.

461.content:
Mayahuel (also: Doctor Mayahuel): A doctor of the Masters of the Night-Wind and mother of Tepoz, who braves the Abyssal invasion to treat the wounded. She exists as an optional rescue.

Status as of 7.1: Branching: alive at the Stadium treating the wounded if rescued; otherwise she does not appear.

462.content:
Melanta (also: Watcher of Melancholy, World-Watch Sentry): An angelic automaton made by Asmoday to keep her Temple of Space. When she vanished he stayed and punished all change in her name. Defeated by the Traveler in 6.5.

Status as of 7.1: Gone: self-destructed in The Final Judgment (6.5).

463.content:
Melus: Navia's butler in the Spina di Rosula. Died in the 4.2 Poisson flood.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: dissolved by Primordial Sea water in the 4.2 Poisson flood.

464.content:
Mikhail: A masked Fatui diplomat posted in Mondstadt, always found beside Lyudmila. He brings the latest news, spins it for the Fatui and refuses to worry.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Mondstadt as of his latest dialogue, which reacts to the Nod-Krai incident. He still waits by the waypoint, sure that the Doctor's trouble will not hurt the Tsaritsa's endeavour.

465.content:
Mitya (also: Energy Commission Specialist, Specialist of the Royal Energy Commission): A chatty energy specialist of the Royal Energy Commission and key researcher on Project Mistilteinn, who skips work for the Korolevskiy Theater. His sentient scarf chokes him when he nearly leaks secrets.

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Snezhnaya at 7.1; Ronova's curse is lifted.

key: Perfected Lord who Carves the Moon and Builds the Sun
466.content:
Moon Carver (also: Houzhang, Perfected Lord who Carves the Moon and Builds the Sun, Xuēyuè Zhúyáng Zhēnjūn): Stag-formed adeptus of Qingyun Peak, disciple of Rex Lapis, called the kindest of the adepti. Stern at Jueyun Karst, comic as the man Houzhang in Liyue Harbor.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as of 7.1; last seen in the 7.1 Moonchase Festival event (limited), taking tea with the adepti at Mt. Aocang.

467.content:
Mountain Shaper (also: Jiehu, Mon-Mon, Adeptus of Mt. Hulao, Lishui Dieshan Zhenjun): A crane adeptus of Liyue who lives on Mt. Hulao and fills its slopes with amber-making plants. In human guise he is Jiehu.

Status as of 7.1: Alive. He lives on Mt. Hulao, visits fellow adepti on Mt. Aocang and appears at Lantern Rites.

468.content:
Mr. Nine (also: Author of Flowers for Princess Fischl, Author of Legend of the Shattered Halberd): Mr. Nine is the pen name of a female former Angel turned Seelie. Her stories, all ideas of her old friend Nicole, include Legend of the Shattered Halberd and Flowers for Princess Fischl.

Status as of 7.1: In Nod-Krai, assigned by Nicole to watch the region, as of 6.2.

469.content:
Mutota (also: Chief Mutota, Chief of the Flower-Feather Clan): Chief of the Flower-Feather Clan in Natlan, a scarred, careful man who teaches that patience and awareness keep warriors alive.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in office as chief at the cutoff, rebuilding after the Abyss attack and keeping order.

470.content:
Naberius (also: Ruler of Life, Mother of Life, Maadteraahka): Ruler of Life, one of the four Shades. Rhinedottir devoured her heart, so her power acts through Rhinedottir while her own mind survives and disapproves.

Status as of 7.1: Her consciousness persists inside Rhinedottir, who uses her authority and attends meetings in her place.

471.content:
Naphis (also: Sage Naphis, Master Naphis, Sir Naphis, Grand Sage Naphis, Amurta Sage): Sage of Amurta and now Grand Sage of the Sumeru Akademiya. Famed for his temper and honest convictions, he was jailed by the corrupt sages he opposed. Tighnari was his student.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; Grand Sage of the Sumeru Akademiya and Sage of Amurta.

472.content:
Nasejuna (also: Vijnanapati Nasejuna): He guided the Pari Sorush and the Traveler to the Great Songs of Khvarena, then revealed he meant them for the Abyss.

Status as of 7.1: A fugitive as of 7.1; his whereabouts are unknown after he fled the Traveler.

473.content:
Nefedov (also: Mr. Nefedov, Podvorye Restaurant Owner): Nefedov is the Volkodlak owner of Podvorye Restaurant in Snezhnograd, a polite, busy host who knows his regulars and runs the dining room with quiet pride. He is the man behind the counter in several Snezhnaya scenes.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and running Podvorye Restaurant as of 7.1.

474.content:
Nihilita (also: Watcher of Nothingness, The Open-Eyed, Nihilita of Nothingness, The Fallen One, Watcher: Fallen Vigil, World-Watch Sentry): A Watcher made by Asmoday who opened his eye after she vanished and left her Temple of Space (6.5).

Status as of 7.1: Alive, unaccounted for after sending the Traveler up.

475.content:
Nikita (also: Starshyna Nikita, Old Man Nikita): Nikita is the Starshyna, or leader, of the Lightkeepers, the order defending Nod-Krai from the Wild Hunt. A broad, grey-bearded man in middle age, he commands from Piramida, where his troops call him "old man".

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in command at Piramida as of 7.1.

476.content:
Octavia (also: O, Wander-Witch, Aunty Tavia): Octavia, codename O, is the Hexenzirkel's Wander-Witch, who travels among the stars and has never appeared in person. She created the pocket realm Miliastra Wonderland and chose the Traveler and Paimon as its new masters.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and travelling as of 7.1; the Traveler and Paimon are now Wonderland's masters.

477.content:
Old Hu (also: 75th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Hu Tao's grandfather, Grandpa Hu): The late 75th director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, Hu Tao's grandfather, remembered for his saying "Live in life, and die in death".

Status as of 7.1: Dead. Appears only as a spirit.

key: That Which Lies in the Deep
478.content:
Osial (also: Overlord of the Vortex, That Which Lies in the Deep, Demon God of the Vortex): Osial, the Overlord of the Vortex, is an ancient Hydro sea god pinned beneath Guyun Stone Forest by Rex Lapis. Childe briefly freed him in 1.1; the Jade Chamber wounded and resealed him.

Status as of 7.1: Sealed under the sea at Guyun Stone Forest since the end of the 1.1 Archon Quest. Not dead.

479.content:
Pacal (also: Chief Pacal, Chief of the Children of Echoes): Chief of the Children of Echoes in Natlan, a big-hearted, food-loving man who never earned an Ancient Name and decided to support others.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, chief of the Children of Echoes, overseeing recovery after the Abyss invasion.

480.content:
Paimon (also: Best Guide in Teyvat, Best Travel Companion Ever, Emergency Food, White Floaty, Flying Lavender Melon): Paimon is the Traveler's floating guide and constant companion, a self-proclaimed "Best Guide in Teyvat" who talks for her quieter partner, chases food and treasure, and never leaves their side. In Snezhnaya (7.0) she learned she is a creation of Celestia, pulled down to Khaenri'ah over five hundred years ago, though she remembers none of it.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and recovered, travelling with the Traveler in Snezhnaya after 7.1. She knows she came from Celestia, but still has no memories of it.

481.content:
Pantalone (also: Regrator, Feofan, Ninth Harbinger): Fatui Harbinger and president of Snezhnaya's state Northland Bank. Centuries old, looks forty-five; a smiling banker who wants money out of the gods' hands.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and active in Snezhnaya as of 7.1.

482.content:
Pavlina (also: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka, Guardian of the Hesperides): Ruler of the House of Hesperides, who repeats a ritual sacrifice to give her people souls.

Status as of 7.1: Dead as of 7.0: she disintegrated into icy mist after the Traveler and Aksinya defeated her.

483.content:
Pevtsova (also: Svetloledovka Resident): Pevtsova is a resident of Svetloledovka, the town beside the Prime Ice cavern, and one of the people the Traveler and Odette rescue from the cave. She remains deeply grateful.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, living in Svetloledovka and helping with its recovery as of 7.1.

484.content:
Pierro (also: The Jester, Eftirvit, Director of the Fatui, The First Fatuus): Immortal since the Cataclysm, he has served the Tsaritsa ever since.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, weakened by the Eye of the Fatui; Project Mistilteinn resumed.

485.content:
Polonsky (also: Fatui delivery officer of Sretomorozsk): Polonsky is the Fatui officer who brings Kresnik Kristall to Sretomorozsk twice a month. He insists he works by the book, and he is the one who finally arrests the thieves.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and, as of 7.1, apparently still the Fatui officer responsible for Sretomorozsk. He has reported the Kristall case to Snezhnograd.

486.content:
Ptashka (also: the girl in the Korolevskiy Theater, the little ghost of the theater): A sick little girl who died in the Korolevskiy Theater and lingers there as a soul, using the name "Tonia" until the truth comes out.

Status as of 7.1: Dead; her soul left into the snow and returned to the Ley Lines.

487.content:
Pulcinella (also: The Rooster, Mirko, Mayor of Snezhnograd, Speaker of the Snezhnograd Veche): Snezhnaya's chief civil executive: a courteous, procedural old fae politician who runs the Veche.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in office as of 7.1, at the centre of Project Stuzha.

488.content:
Pulonia (also: Prospective Undulation Localized Observing and Investigating Automaton, Sandrone's robot, Sandrone's attendant, Marionette's robot): A towering clockwork automaton built by Alain Guillotin, Sandrone's companion and guard. Wrecked by Dottore in Descending Moon.

Status as of 7.1: Inoperative; Dottore destroyed his body in Descending Moon (6.3).

489.content:
Rahman: Leader of an Eremite band in the Land of Upper Setekh. He first fights the Traveler's party, then helps overthrow the Sages.

Status as of 7.1: Alive as of 7.1, back in the desert helping Setaria bring teaching and supplies to Eremites.

490.content:
Rampana (also: Theater Staff Rampana): Rampana is a Korolevskiy Theater staff member who announces the "Spirit Seeker" trial performance. She is one of the victims of the sleeping deaths in Wraith's Nocturne, with Kulish the third and fourth to die.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. She was found lifeless on the stage the morning after the second night, with Kulish.

491.content:
Rana (also: Forest Watcher Rana, Rana of Vimara Village): Rana is a Forest Watcher of Vimara Village who guides the Traveler through the rainforest in the Aranyaka quests. After falling ill with the Withering, she is saved by a Bija and receives a Dendro Vision.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and travelling with Arana after receiving her Vision. Her later movements are not stated.

492.content:
Raskolnikov (also: Poruchik Raskolnikov, Raskolnikov - Poruchik): A strict Fatui Poruchik who commands the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau on Paha Isle. He expects every order obeyed to the letter.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and in command of the Design Bureau; no appearance after the 6.0 quest was found.

493.content:
Raumhilda (also: Hilda, young Hilda, Zeitlind's older sister): Raumhilda, known as Hilda, was a lively young woman from Mondstadt who entered the Temple of Space and gave up her memories to confront its tyrant, then left and has not been seen since.

Status as of 7.1: Missing. She left the Temple of Space and "has not returned". Her grave is empty.

494.content:
Rerir (also: Rächer of Solnari, Racher of Solnari, Master of the Wild Hunt, Blasphemy Against Death): A Khaenri'ahn Sinner and master of Nod-Krai's Wild Hunt, born from the fragments of his body.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 he is in the moon's reflection, at peace.

495.content:
Rhinedottir (also: Gold, R, Sage-Witch, Ruler of Life, Rhine): Khaenri'ahn alchemist 'Gold', one of the Five Sinners. She created Albedo and Durin and holds the Ruler of Life's seat after devouring Naberius.

Status as of 7.1: Alive; as of 7.1 Ruler of Life, merged with Naberius, after meeting the Tsaritsa.

496.content:
Ronova (also: Ruler of Death, Arbiter of the Heavenly Principles, Paralogism's Outcast, Tuonetar, Mother of the Underworld, Lady of the Underworld, Grim Reaper): Ronova is the Ruler of Death, one of the Four Shades that the Heavenly Principles made from themselves when they came to Teyvat. She governed every death in the world: she could define its form or deny it outright. She cursed the Khaenri'ahns with immortality during the cataclysm. In Snezhnaya (7.0-7.1) she laid a Curse of Death on the nation's research. Celestia stripped her of her authority, Pierro struck her down, and she is presumed dead as of 7.1.

Status as of 7.1: Presumed dead as of 7.1. Celestia revoked her authority for abusing death in Snezhnaya. Pierro then mortally wounded her, and with her last act she made the Celestial Nail above the Cryo Dragon's corpse crumble.

497.content:
Rotwang (also: Rauthvangi, The Professor, mad monk, undying serpent): Called Rotwang at the Belyi Tsar's court, obsessed with the Abyss (his "pitch-black Elysium"); destroyed in 6.3.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: destroyed in 6.3 by the Traveler and Illuga.

498.content:
Rukh Shah (also: Parchamdar Rukh Shah): Parchamdar of the Corps of Thirty, in charge of the Eremites in Sumeru City. He is the youngest person ever to hold the post.

Status as of 7.1: Active as Parchamdar as of 7.1. In 6.6 he reports to the Sages from Caravan Ribat.

499.content:
Rushd (also: Haravatat Sage, Sage of the Haravatat Darshan): Rushd is the current Haravatat sage of the Sumeru Akademiya and the youngest of its six sages. He joins the crisis council during the Irminsul anomaly, urges backup plans and doubts the Akasha restart.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving as Haravatat sage in 6.6, helping run the evacuation and the Akasha plan.

500.content:
Ruu (also: Ruu of Tsurumi Island, the singing boy of Tsurumi): A boy of ancient Tsurumi Island, sacrificed to the Thunderbird Kapatcir, who lingers as a spirit repeating the island's last day.

Status as of 7.1: Lingers on Tsurumi Island after the curse was lifted, grateful.

501.content:
Samail (also: Samail the Straight Shooter): An Eremite of Thutmose who hunted King Deshret's throne and the Golden Slumber. He killed Ufairah, took Jeht hostage and was lured into the Slumber by Jebrael.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. He sat on Deshret's throne and entered the Golden Slumber in Version 3.1.

502.content:
Sarin (also: Branch Master Sarin, Nod-Krai Branch Master, Mr. Sarin): A warm, polite administrator who offers local tips and commissions, and speaks of the weather when he means Fatui movements.

Status as of 7.1: Runs the Nod-Krai branch; took part in the Guild's 7.0 tournament.

503.content:
Scarlett (also: Successor of J): Scarlett is a courteous visitor to Mondstadt who, during the Windblume's Breath event (3.5), turns out to be the successor of the late Hexenzirkel witch J. She slipped a prophecy into a storybook and used it to lead others to the Hexenzirkel's lantern.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, last seen in Mondstadt at the end of Windblume's Breath. No later appearance found through 7.1.

504.content:
Schubert (also: Schubert Lawrence): Eula's pompous uncle from the disgraced Lawrence Clan, who secretly gives the Fatui a map of Mondstadt's defences, hoping to restore his family's rule.

Status as of 7.1: Last seen under arrest by Eula and two Knights of Favonius at the end of her Story Quest (1.5).

505.content:
Scourge of Endless Decay (also: Pathfinder to the Bedeviled Sky, Nightmare's Avatar): A scheming Abyssal entity sealed under Kipumaki Cliff, which served Rotwang's plan to open the false sky. It stalks the Lightkeepers with illusions, and is destroyed by Illuga's squad and the Traveler.

Status as of 7.1: Dead. Destroyed in the Chasm of Endless Decay beneath Kipumaki Cliff by the Traveler and Illuga's squad.

506.content:
Seamus Pegg (also: Cardinal of Daybreak, Seneschal of the Church of Favonius, Cardinal Seamus, Simon Page): Cardinal of Daybreak and Seneschal of the Church of Favonius; Nod-Krai-born ex-adventurer, father of Jean and Barbara, back from Varka's expedition.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, back at the Favonius Cathedral.

507.content:
Sebas (also: Rhinedottir's butler, the butler cat): Sebas is a dark blue, star-patterned cat who is really an alchemical being and Rhinedottir's butler. He delivers her messages and calls himself Albedo's elder.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and presumably in Rhinedottir's service as of the 6.2 quests.

508.content:
Sedene: A Melusine officer at the Palais Mermonia's front desk. Firm about rules, kind to visitors, fond of cake.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and still at the Palais Mermonia desk after 4.2.

509.content:
Sedile: Sedile is a Marechaussee Phantom agent whose usual work is checking sites and gathering information in Fontaine. At present Sedile is on a day off in Merusea Village, resting and hoping to stay out of trouble.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1, alive and unchanged: on a day off in Merusea Village, inside the body of the ancient being Elynas.

510.content:
Serpent of All Evils (also: Raimo, the Serpent of All Evils, the sinner of Dreadshade Mire, monster of the swamp): Once Raimo, a human official at the Belyi Tsar's court and Rotwang's disciple, now an Abyssal monster sealed in Dreadshade Mire. He blames everyone but himself.

Status as of 7.1: Defeated in Dreadshade Mire (6.3). A corrupted form is heard again at Piramida.

511.content:
Setaria (also: Setaria of the Akademiya, the Grand Sage's secretary): A scholar from the Great Red Sand who rose to serve Grand Sage Azar at the Sumeru Akademiya, then chose to leave and teach her own people.

Status as of 7.1: Alive, out of the Akademiya and working on education in the desert.

512.content:
Shakir (also: Sage Shakir, Rtawahist Sage, Sage of the Rtawahist Darshan): Shakir is the Sumeru Akademiya's Sage of the Rtawahist Darshan, the school of stars and foresight. He looks stern but speaks softly, and he once taught Layla.

Status as of 7.1: Alive and serving as Rtawahist Sage; not mentioned after the Irminsul crisis ended.

513.content:
Shesepankh (also: Saint Shesepankh, Most-Holy, Shesepankh the Most-Holy): Saint Shesepankh, the Most-Holy, is an intelligent construct built by King Deshret to oversee the world's Jinn. Leisurely and endlessly curious, he was awakened in 6.6 to vote on opening Aaru.

Status as of 7.1: Awake since 6.6, apparently maintaining Aaru and visiting the Temple of Silence.

514.content:
Shishkin (also: Liaison Shishkin, Liaison Officer Shishkin): Shishkin is the friendly liaison of Sretomorozsk, a go-between for townspeople and the Fatui who deliver Kresnik Kristall. In truth he and the mayor have been stealing and reselling it.

Status as of 7.1: Arrested in 7.0 and sent to Snezhnograd to await judgement. His verdict is not shown.

515.content:
Shram (also: Mercenary Shram): An easygoing mercenary snowed in at the Korolevskiy Theater with the Traveler, he is the ghost of a bodyguard killed there over four hundred years ago.

Status as of 7.1: Dead long before 7.0. His soul walked into the snowstorm and returned to the Ley Lines in Winter's Mysterious Silence.

516.content:
Shuyu (also: Xianyun's disciple, Yuandai's granddaughter): A young girl from a family of exorcists on Mt. Tianheng, granddaughter of Yuandai and the first human-world disciple of the adeptus Xianyun (Cloud Retainer).

Status as of 7.1: Alive in Liyue Harbor, living and training with Xianyun at Chihu Rock.

517.content:
Signora (also: La Signora, The Fair Lady, Rosalyne, Crimson Witch of Flame, Crimson Witch of Embers): The Eighth Harbinger, a proud Snezhnayan diplomat sent to take Archons' Gnoses for the Tsaritsa. Personal name: Rosalyne.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: executed by the Raiden Shogun in Inazuma (2.1); entombed in Snezhnaya.

518.content:
Sigurd (also: The One Who Swore to Hunt the Hunt, Starshyna Sigurd, Sigurd the Starshyna, Uncle Sigurd): A legendary Starshyna who vanished fighting the Wild Hunt about a decade ago and still fights it as a corrupted revenant.

Status as of 7.1: Dead, yet wandering as a corrupted spirit. Once the Traveler returns his relics and defeats him, he says it is finally over.

519.content:
Silver (also: Navia's attendant, Spina di Rosula attendant): Younger of the two attendants guarding Navia of the Spina di Rosula in Fontaine; a nervous but loyal bodyguard who calls her "Demoiselle". He died in 4.2, dissolved by Primordial Seawater in Poisson.

Status as of 7.1: Dead: dissolved by Primordial Seawater in Poisson during the Deluge of Wrathful Waters (4.2) while helping others. Afterwards he appears only in Navia's memory, her dream, and as an Oceanid.

520.content:
Silverwing (also: Jade-Plumed Silverwing, Xuanniao Adeptus, Silverwing the swallow adeptus): A swallow-born adeptus who kept a yearly Moonchase promise to the Wind Reader.

Status as of 7.1: Unknown; Zhongli says she has not entirely departed while swallows fly in Liyue.

521.content:
Sinuhe (also: Chief Sinuhe, Nefer's father): Chief of the desert Shimti tribe and Nefer's father, who tried to save his people from thirst and was destroyed with them.

Status as of 7.1: Dead, killed with most of his tribe by the Iab in the past; known only through Nefer's memories and letters.

522.content:
Siraj (also: Overmind, Siraj Number 1): A brilliant, bitter Vahumana researcher whose forbidden thesis on a collective consciousness was rejected; he secretly made it real and tried to use it to seize a sage's seat.

Status as of 7.1: Arrested by the matra at the end of Version 3.4 to stand trial; his associates were rounded up. The wiki says he is imprisoned.

523.content:
